messages:
Nicole (CS): Heads-up: Marigold showing 20-40% p50/p95 tail latency increase over the last 12h after onboarding spike. seeing ~6s p95 on short prompts. :warning: Need a quick perf nudge before the renewal call in 3w.

Tess (AM - Marigold): Saw it too. Execs already noticed a few slow replies. Their workload: chat-heavy, avg seq len ~128, lots of short back-and-forth. Renewal in 3 weeks, so low-friction wins matter.

Omar (Eng Runtime): Do we have traces or flamegraphs? can we repro on their dedicated staging? link to traces: https://redwood.internal/traces/marigold/4128498000

Vijay (ML): Quick read: they're on open-7b-unfused (fp32). No quant or optimized kernels. Suggest pilot q4_0 (or int8 if we need more speed) + prefix/KV caching. Expect ~25-35% p95 reduction and ~40-50% token cost drop depending on batching.

Alex (SE): I can craft a small canary route. Proposed rollout snippet:```yaml
model: open-7b-q4_0
route: sfo-dedicated
batching:
  max_tokens: 512
  max_batch_ms: 20
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_key: session_id
traffic_split: 5%
```
Keep temp and top_p same as prod.

Tess (AM - Marigold): Important: Marigold is sensitive to hallucinations on system prompts. We need an eval on their prompt set and an intent-match threshold before wider rollout.

Vijay (ML): Will run 500-sample eval against their corpus with automatic metrics (intent match, factuality spot-checks). Aim for >=98% intent match. I'll post results in ~30m and upload CSV to the shared folder.

Nicole (CS): Action: schedule 4h canary US morning (low risk window). @deploy-bot please create canary and alert if p95 regression > 10% or RL (response-level) quality drop >2%. Also note this in the renewal deck as a cost/latency win.

deploy-bot: Canary created: marigold-quant-canary-4128500000. Details: 5% traffic -> open-7b-q4_0 in sfo-dedicated. Monitoring: latency p50/p95, error rate, cost delta, and custom quality hook. Dash: https://redwood.internal/canaries/marigold-quant-canary-4128500000

Alex (SE): Rolling the canary now. Logs: "warmup complete, kv cache primed". Initial telemetry (first 10m): p95 down 28%, avg latency down 18%, cost per token down ~48%. No errors.

Vijay (ML): Uploaded eval: https://redwood.internal/evals/marigold/4128500000.csv. Summary: intent match 99.1%, avg token reduction 48%, no significant increase in hallucination flags at sampling temp 0.7.

Tess (AM - Marigold): I'll share the early results with the customer and ask them to flag anything odd. If they sign off, we can plan full swap during their low-traffic weekend. :thumbsup:

Nicole (CS): Great. I'll update the renewal materials: mention latency improvements and projected monthly cost savings. Next steps: keep canary for 24h, get customer QA, if stable -> schedule full route change. I'll ping legal if we need a small addendum for model change.

Alex (SE): Noted. I'll keep logs and artifacts in the canary folder and tag the run with #quant-swap.

Omar (Eng Runtime): One operational note: if we see cache thrashing because of many short sessions, we can fallback to mixed routing (q4_0 for 60% requests, fp32 for the rest) as a safety valve.

Nicole (CS): Thanks team — this feels low-risk/high-impact. I'll update the ticket and close loop with the AM after customer check. :eyes:
